note: Literature supports haploinsufficiency of PSMD12 as the unified mechanism across both intragenic truncating SNVs and 17q24 CNV microdeletions.

evidence.text: Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome is caused by PSMD12 haploinsufficiency, encompassing individuals harboring truncating single nucleotide variants or copy-number variant deletions involving PSMD12.

source.title: Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome: expanding the clinical and molecular phenotype
source.quote: We report 24 additional unrelated patients with STISS with various truncating single nucleotide variants or copy-number variant deletions involving PSMD12.

evidence.text: PSMD12 haploinsufficiency causes Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome across inherited/de novo truncating variants and 17q24 microdeletions.

source.title: Does It Run in Your Family? Inherited Truncating PSMD12 Variants Broaden the Phenotypic Spectrum of Stankiewicz‐Isidor Syndrome
source.quote: Haploinsufficiency of PSMD12, which encodes a subunit of the core component of the proteasome, causes Stankiewicz-Isidor syndrome (STISS)
